title: Trey Anastasio lands the changes in Slave to the Traffic Light
seoTitle: Trey Anastasio Slave to the Traffic Light Solo | Gametape Licks
summary: Watch a long, patient Trey solo follow the chords by landing on the notes that name them.
description: Watch Trey Anastasio play Slave to the Traffic Light at the Beacon Jams and hear how his lines land on the 3rd as the chords change. Includes a timestamped listening guide.
intro: Slave to the Traffic Light gives Trey room to say one thing slowly. He starts on acoustic, the strings and horns fill in around him, and by the second half he is on electric guitar and the solo has somewhere to go.

Listen for the moment each chord changes. The 3rd arrives on the downbeat, and the phrase after it repeats the same shape in a new spot. That is lesson 1 in a real setting: find the 3rd, land on it, then let the scale carry you to the next change.
Put the video on at half the page width and keep the fretboard map from the lesson next to it. When you hear a change, point at where the 3rd lives before he plays it.
